19. Then Exhibit 4 is an index of RS Plot No. 396 that shows that this Plot has come from CS Plot No. 421 and 423, under CS Khatian No. 240. It does not prove any the or possession of the plaintiff in the suit property. 

 20. Exhibit 5, which is CS Kha tin No. 241, refers to CS Plot No. 387, which is not the suit property. Exhibit 5(Ka) is RS Khatian No. 240, which contains RS Plot No. 396 and 6 other RS Plots. All these Plots totally covered 2.89 acres of land of which RS Plot No. 396 contain 30 decimals of land and the plaintiff has claimed 20 decimals of land out of these 30 decimals of land. But, there is no boundary to the property claimed. 

 21. On the other hand, the defendant's case is that as stated in paragraph No. 9 of the written statement that the suit property along with other non suit property was owned by one Abdur Rahman and others settled their land to their tenants or raiyot, but their entire land were put in auction for default of payment of arrear rent and the questioned property that included the suit property. On 20-9-1937, in an open auction, the defendants had purchased the same and the sale was confirmed and they were given possession as well as boinama (sale certificate). Thereafter, their names have been recorded in the RS and SA Khatian in the ordinary course of business and since then they have been paying rent to the Government. 

 23. Then from RS Khatian No. 240 and SA Khatian No. 349 was that the suit property, lying at corresponding RS and SA Plot No. 396 has been recorded in the name of the auction purchaser Abdul Hakim Mollah, vide Exhibit Gha and Gha(1), respectively. The CS Khatian No. 241 has been proved and marked as Exhibit Umo in the name of Abdul Hakim Mollah and others which is Exhibit Umo of the defendants (Exhibit 5 of the plaintiff). The CS Khatian No. 242 comprises 49.49 acres of land in the name of Abdul Hakim Mollah and these were not the suit property. 

 26. In the judgment of the trial court, 1 also find that, it has found that the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 have purchased the suit property in auction on 20-9-1937, as claimed by them, alongwith 20 decimals of the suit property lying in suit Plot No. 421. It has also found that the RS and SA Khatian No. 396 was recorded in the name of the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 and that they have paid rent to the Government, vide Exhibit Cha and Cha(1).
